subject: prd/docgate
statement: At each replay boundary, docgate shall classify a Q as answered if and only if either its validated replay-base checkpoint carries `question_answered: true` under FR-43 or a successful `answer Q<n>` operation targeting that ID occurs after that replay base and at or before the boundary; otherwise it shall classify the Q as unanswered. Repair routing shall not read or interpret the Q row's free-text `Status` cell, and missing or invalid required checkpoint state shall fail under FR-43 rather than default to unanswered.
rationale: merged Q status cells contain multiple open-like forms and answer-rendered prose, while operations before the latest checkpoint are outside the replay window; both text classification and replay-window-only classification lose a decidable answer state
fit_criterion: Q rows whose Status cells contain `open`, qualified open prose, `resolved (001) — …`, or arbitrary text but have neither a true replay-base value nor a post-base successful answer op classify unanswered and route to `answer`; after a successful `answer Q1`, another `answer Q1` and a section mutation are red with the `supersede Q1` fresh-Q remedy; after a semantic-no-op checkpoint, the same Q remains answered solely through `question_answered: true`, and a fresh Q introduced after the checkpoint begins false
